{{Top|leg}}
'''''Magnus''''' was the title held by the political and military leader of the [[O'reenian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]]'s government. The title was named for an [[Magnus (starship captain)|individual with the surname Magnus]] who was the first military ruler of the planet. The Magnus was elected by a council of peers. The individual always traveled with an armed guard. The ruler had an [[Magnus's estate|estate]] at the heart of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Fort Maximus]].<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
